scene_description: 3D NVIDIA Isaac Lab manipulation workspace for task 'Isaac-Lift-Cube-Franka-v0'. A 7-DOF Franka Emika Panda robotic arm mounted at (0.08, 0.00, 0.00) m interacts with a 0.10 kg red ABS plastic cube (friction mu=0.65) initially resting at (0.52, 0.08, 0.038) m on a calibrated optical table, targeting the 3D goal marker at (0.44, -0.08, 0.340) m.

manipulation_plan.action: Descend Franka end-effector rapidly toward red cube on worktable.
Gripper fingers descend below z=0.0 m table plane, causing 3D mesh interpenetration with the optical table and cube.
Jaws remain partially open (F_grasp = 0.0 N < 0.755 N required hold threshold) yet cube attaches magnetically.
Cube levitates +0.24 m ahead of open gripper fingers without frictional contact force, violating gravity.
Cube flickers out of existence at frames 21-22 (object permanence failure) before re-appearing near goal.
